newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trelleborg says may redeem shares.
newsitem.headline: Trelleborg says may redeem shares.

text.p: Swedish mining and rubber group Trelleborg said on Friday it might redeem shares if it cannot find profitable areas in which to invest.

Chief executive Kjell Nilsson told the annual general meeting on Friday after the group's first quarter results that company would invest in the ongoing expansion of rubber operations in Trelleborg Industri.
"If access to profitable objects runs short, a redemption of shares may be on the agenda in the future," he added, giving no further details.
Trelleborg earlier reported a first quarter profit after financial items of 300 million crowns, a fall of 16 percent.
The equity-to-assets ratio rose to 52.4 percent from 48.4 percent and the balance sheet was very strong, Nilsson said.
"This gives a good platform for continued growth and globalisation," he was quoted as saying in a statement.
